sentences.text: Murari Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 17 August, 2023
Bench: Bela M. Trivedi, Dipankar Datta

Item No.8 Court No.15 Sec
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Petition for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No. 9602/2023
 (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 03-07-2023
 in Crlmn No. 44495/2022 passed by the High Court Of Judicature At
 Patna)
 Murari Kumar Yadav Petitione
 Versus
 State Of Bihar & Anr. Responden
 (For Admission and Ia No.154543/2023-EXEMPTION From Filing O.T.)
 Date : 17-08-2023 This matter was called on for hearing today.
 Coram :
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Bela M. Trivedi
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Dipankar Datta
 For Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Kumar Piyush Pushkar, Adv.
 Mr. Mukesh Kumar, Aor
 For Respondent(s)
 Upon
hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Issue notice returnable in two weeks.

Till the next date of hearing, the petitioner  Murari Kumar Yadav shall not be arrested in connection with First Information Report (FIR) No. 78/2021 dated 18.07.2021 registered with Police Station  Mahila LNMU, Sub Division  Sadar, District  Darbhanga, Bihar for the offence(s)
punishable under Sections 498A, 379, 323/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
 (DEEPAK GUGLANI) (R.S. NARAYA  AR-cum-PS ASSISTANT REGI Murari Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174697813/
